authority: apostila-cga-2026; exhaustive sweep of every corpus occurrence of each form
method: scripts/score_form_polysemy.py + stratify_precision.py + build_sweep_queue.py; 467 farthest-from-centroid occurrences read, then every occurrence of each suspect form read exhaustively
reason: Exhaustive sweep found 58 wrong match events across nine forms. Three were missing senses, not broad labels.

operations.why: `principal` is the commonest Portuguese adjective for `main`. 18 of its 28 occurrences are `principal característica`, `principal fator de risco`, `a principal desvantagem`. The financial sense always names an amount.
The collocation the corpus uses for the financial sense, twice, both correct.
`à medida que` means `as` and merely contains `medida`. All six wrong occurrences are this conjunction; the other thirteen are genuine measures.
Plural `medidas` splits evenly between statistical measures and `adotar medidas` meaning steps a regulator takes.
Every occurrence is `o termo X significa` (the word) or `termo de cessão` (a deed). The forward sense is always marked by the preposition.
Seven occurrences — `operações a termo`, `venda a termo`, `contratos a termos` — all the forward sense.
`posição Ativa (Credora)` is the asset side of a contract and `swap ATIVA em pós-fixada` is a swap leg; neither is active management.
`gestão ativa` already anchors the concept 17 times; this adds the allocation phrasing.
`prazo de duração do fundo` is the fund's lifetime, not interest-rate duration. `duration` stays automatic in both languages and is what the material actually uses.
Its single occurrence means `to regard as`, not `to check`. `verificar` carries the checking sense and belongs to action.verify.
Cross-border capital flows are a balance-of-payments notion, not a security's cash flow.
In this corpus bare `Value` is the investment style eleven times out of twelve. `valor` carries the quantity sense in Portuguese and stays automatic.

record.definition: The management style that selects assets trading below their fundamental worth, contrasted with Growth.
record.source: CGA 2026 course material, adjudicated against corpus contexts

en: The value investing style assumes shares are mispriced.
pt-BR: O estilo Value assume que as ações estão incorretamente precificadas.

en: Do not use value investing for the numeric value of an asset.
pt-BR: Não use value investing para o valor numérico de um ativo.

operations.why: The sweep kept reporting `Value` as wrong for quantity.value. The label was not too broad — the style sense was simply absent from the registry.

record.definition: The regulatory act by which a fund, class or manager is entered with the supervisor and authorised to operate.
record.source: CGA 2026 course material, adjudicated against corpus contexts

en: The class must obtain its own regulatory registration.
pt-BR: O funcionamento do fundo depende do seu prévio registro na CVM.

en: Do not use regulatory registration for a database record.
pt-BR: Não use registro regulatório para um registro de banco de dados.

operations.why: Ten of the twelve occurrences of `registro` are registration with the CVM, not a stored record. Registering the missing sense as automatic makes the collision demoter fire, which is the correct outcome: bare `registro` is genuinely ambiguous and both sides drop to review, while `registro na CVM` and `registro de banco de dados` keep each concept anchored.
